# EMPIRIC TREATMENT: VENTILATOR ASSOCIATED PNEUMONIA (VAP)

Pneumonia occurring 48 hours or more after endotracheal intubation

# Empiric Treatment (see below for multidrug resistance (MDR))

Obtain MRSA nasal PCR and sputum culture before antibiotics, whenever possible.

Narrow therapy based on results of culture and susceptibility tests. Discontinue

MRSA and/or Pseudomonas coverage if not isolated from respiratory cultures.

Discontinue MRSA coverage if MRSA nasal PCR negative.

[Re-evaluate Nosocomial pneumonia at 72 hours](nosocomial-pneumonia-re-evaluation-at-72-hours)

Preferred:

See below for history of Gram-negative resistance to preferred antimicrobials

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R  for 7 days](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

<OR>

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-pip-taz4-5gm-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-vanco15mg-kg)

for 7 days

History of Gram-negative resistance to cefepime and piperacillin-tazobactam

within the last year:

[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h R <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h R for 7 days](orz-set-abx-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R,DI <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R for](orz-set-abx-levo-750mg-iv-q24h-and-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

7 days

# MDR gram-negative/high severity of illness and MDR risks

> Prior intravenous antibiotic use within 90 days (especially broad spectrum)

> Septic shock at the time of VAP

> ARDS preceding VAP

> 5 or more days of hospitalization prior to the occurrence of VAP

> Acute renal replacement therapy prior to VAP onset

[<ADD> Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV once R,O to one of the regimens above](psjizid-tobramycin-5-mg-kg-iv-once)
